author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಉಚ್ಚನೀಚತೆ ಭೇದ ಕಂದಕ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿರೆ
ನಿಚ್ಚಳವು ಜಗಕೆಂದು ಅವನತಿಯ ದಾರಿ
ಹುಚ್ಚು ಕೆಲವರಿಗಿಹುದು ಮೇಲರಿಮೆ ಕೀಳರಿಮೆ
ಹಚ್ಚು ಸಮರಸದೀಪ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If distinctions of high and low create a chasm,
it is clearly the road to the world’s ruin;
some have a madness of superiority or inferiority;
light the lamp of harmony, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Divisions of high and low split society and lead to decline. Both superiority and inferiority are forms of madness. Light the lamp of harmony instead.
